brief:
Israeli forces sealed a West Bank village for more than 20 hours, Middle East Eye reported, as Palestinian officials described the closure and concurrent settler attacks as part of a coordinated campaign to displace Palestinians from their land. The blockade prevented residents from entering or leaving the community during the period.

Officials characterized the military seizure alongside violent settler assaults as elements of a broader strategy targeting Palestinian territories and communities. The incident occurred as violence by Israeli settlers has intensified across the West Bank in recent weeks, with attacks on Palestinian property and residents becoming more frequent. The closure represents one of several restrictions imposed on Palestinian movement and access to land in the region.
